title: Beyond Pixel Reconstruction: Retrieval-Guided Glyph-Aware Restoration for Low-Resource Manchu Historical Documents
abstract: arXiv:2610.00315v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Historical Manchu documents preserve invaluable linguistic and cultural heritage, yet their digitization is hindered by severe degradations and the scarcity of paired training data. Existing document restoration methods primarily optimize pixel-level reconstruction, which can produce visually plausible results while failing to preserve the structural identity of Manchu glyphs. To address this limitation, we propose a retrieval-guided glyph-aware restoration framework that goes beyond pixel reconstruction by explicitly incorporating glyph-level structural knowledge. Our method retrieves relevant glyph exemplars to provide structural guidance during restoration and integrates this information into the reconstruction process, improving the recovery of degraded character structures under low-resource conditions. translated_title: 超越像素重建：面向低资源满文历史文档的检索引导字形感知修复
translated_abstract: 满文历史文献保存着宝贵的语言与文化遗产，然而其数字化进程受到严重退化问题以及配对训练数据稀缺的阻碍。现有的文档修复方法主要优化像素级重建，虽然能够产生视觉上合理的结果，却无法保留满文字形的结构特性。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了一种检索引导的字形感知修复框架，通过显式融入字形级结构知识，超越了像素重建的范畴。我们的方法检索相关的字形范例，在修复过程中提供结构指导，并将这些信息整合到重建过程中，从而在低资源条件下改善退化字符结构的恢复效果。在满文历史文档上开展的大量实验表明，所提出的方法在图像修复质量（原文此处截断）方面均有所提升。
tldr: 该论文提出一种检索引导的字形感知修复框架，通过检索字形范例并显式融入字形级结构知识，突破了传统像素级重建的局限，在低资源条件下更有效地恢复满文历史文档中退化的字符结构。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a retrieval-guided glyph-aware restoration framework that goes beyond pixel reconstruction by retrieving glyph exemplars and explicitly incorporating glyph-level structural knowledge, improving the recovery of degraded Manchu character structures in low-resource historical documents.
